pages.scan: I opened page-05.png with Read and looked at it, then read only the request JSON. No other production files were read. Panel 1 is wide, with meera's face box on the left and ravi's on the right. Meera's balloon is top-left: "Welbuk Health is designed to help patients stay connected with their care." Ravi does not speak or react visibly. Middle row, left panel: ravi asks "So I can keep useful information in one place?" A teal label box at the bottom-left says "WELBUK HEALTH for patients". Middle row, right panel: meera answers "That's the idea. Let's walk through what is available to you." Panel 4 is wide: a top-left narration caption says "A smoother visit. A more connected experience." and ravi's face box sits alone in the lower middle with no dialogue.
pages.observation: Read left to right, top to bottom, the order is natural. Ravi's question picks up 'stay connected' and meera answers it straight away in the next panel, so no answer is skipped. Every tail points to the right face box, and all text is readable. Three unclear points. First, ravi gives no visible reaction in panel 1, so the first beat leans entirely on the art. Second, the teal 'WELBUK HEALTH for patients' label sits in the speaking panel, so it is unclear whether it is a screen or app label in the scene or a caption. If it is not tied to an object in the art, it could read as an extra narrator voice. Third, meera says "Let's walk through what is available to you," but panel 4 skips the walkthrough and goes to a closing caption over ravi alone. That jump in time or place has no transition cue and could feel like a missing beat, unless the next page shows the walkthrough.
